title: Vacuum lifting apparatus for cylindrical articles

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a vacuum lifting apparatus but does not mention it being cordless, handheld, or battery-powered.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: Each backing plate has a resilient seal secured thereto in the form of a continuous pneumatic tube which projects outwardly from the plate to form a cushion and a seal, and is arranged with side sections and end sections forming
features.note: The reference describes a 'resilient seal' in the form of a 'continuous pneumatic tube' that projects outwardly to form a seal and a suction space, which is equivalent to a flexible sealing lip bounding a sealed region.
features.refuted: The quote describes a 'continuous pneumatic tube' that forms a cushion and a seal, not a 'flexible sealing lip on a suction cup'. While both relate to sealing, the mechanism and structure described are different.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.quote: means at the backing plate through which suction can be applied to said suction space
features.note: The reference discloses means for applying suction to the suction space, but does not specify an electric vacuum pump mounted within a rigid body.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.note: The reference does not mention any pressure sensor or means for monitoring the vacuum level.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators or thresholds related to vacuum levels.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning thresholds.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference does not mention a rechargeable battery or any power source for a vacuum pump.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference does not describe any warning indicators.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a lifting apparatus but does not specify a single-hand portable design or that all components are carried by a rigid body without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a vacuum lifting apparatus with a resilient seal and suction space, which aligns with some core concepts of the subject invention, but lacks details on portability, power source, and safety features like vacuum monitoring and warning indicators.
